details: This package is an empty placeholder rather than a library release. The tarball is 339 bytes across two files: package/package.json, which contains only the name, version 0.0.0-stage, a "stub": true marker and the description "Temporary package placeholder for staged publishing" with no main, scripts, bin, dependencies or lifecycle hooks, and package/README.md, a 190-byte note titled "Temporary Holding Version" stating that an operational version is awaiting a staged release. Installing this version executes no code and opens no network connection. The package occupies the name "baileys" — the canonical name of the @whiskeysockets/baileys WhatsApp socket library — under a different, unrelated scope, with no repository, license or author attribution linking it to that project. It therefore serves only to reserve a namespace under a name it imitates, ahead of a later publish. There is no malware payload, C2 host or credential access in this version's bytes; any such behaviour would arrive in a subsequent non-stub release under the same scope, which should be treated as untrusted and compared against the upstream @whiskeysockets/baileys source.
